digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command grammar
propositions: Advanced command grammars (bridge, reconciler, audit, LLM, workflow, identity, gate) currently use inline argparse construction mixed with manual dispatch, causing 21 unsafe/incomplete top-level help forms
Every registered advanced grammar must be extracted into S2a side-effect-free parser factory contracts that remain lean and import no optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira, workflow executor)
Parse-failure handling must be reconciled: migrated handlers currently catching SystemExit(2) must catch ParseError instead and emit identical exit code and stderr/usage bytes

Bespoke parser presentation (usage=, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) for verify-opcert, verify-commit, verify-authorship, remote-cert, trusted-env, and nested bridge parsers must be preserved via optional keyword passthroughs in the S2a factory
All advanced routes must have valid factory references and be deterministically S2d-generation-ready without executing handlers or importing optional runtimes
Production-path tests must verify no delta in nested selection, argv acceptance, diagnostics, exit codes, and byte-identical help output for commands with custom presentation
